propositions: Four read-only, deterministic metric functions must be implemented in git_metrics.py: module_size_distribution (distribution of .py modules against hard cap), cap_change_events (commits changing the limit file), churn (insertions/deletions from git log), and refactor_to_addition_ratio (deletions/insertions ratio).

Each metric function must be registered into the c085 REGISTRY with a single-arg compute adapter pulling repo_root, since, until from context, with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high'.
module_size_distribution must scan src/rebar/**/*.py at a ref against the cap from .github/module-size-limit.txt, returning count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
cap_change_events must parse git log over .github/module-size-limit.txt for old/new limit values in a commit range, returning a list of dicts (or empty list for no changes).
refactor_to_addition_ratio must return deletions/insertions ratio from git log --numstat or None when insertions is zero; churn must return exact summed insertions and deletions from the same source.
